posts.author: mrmendoza
posts.body:
Hello!
As an introduction, I have VisuStella plugins, maybe it will help.
But speaking about the essence of my problem.
I am looking for a method for additional conditions for using a given skill by both the player and the opponents.
For example, I would like the skill "Orc buster" to be usable only against orcs as the name suggests. So I am looking for a method to make the skill usable against a specific enemy (for example enemy 002)
Secondly, I would like the same to apply to enemies.
For example, I want the skill "Elfen Doom" to be usable only against a specific actor in a situation when another effect is applied to him (paralysis, for example)
Is it possible to obtain such conditions for using a skill without additional dedicated plugins but based on the ones I already have?

Click to expand...
That is also correct, i want to exclude specific actor as potential target.
I suppose i could use some dedicated plugin that would give a specification to actors that would identify them as a "race" and then set the skill to correlate with that specification, but I think a simpler but perhaps more time-consuming method would be to simply exclude the actor as a target for the skill by simple commands.
at the moment I am using the code below written in skill note window but I have the impression that sometimes it doesn't work properly
maybe i should write actor id inside brackets, although I found somewhere that it should rather look like this.
Spoiler:
Code
<AI Priority>
condition: target.actorId() === 1 && $gameSwitches.value(201)
</AI Priority>
I also read that when I want the enemy to use a given skill exclusively for a given actor and additionally when a given switch is enabled, I should construct the code as follows.
Spoiler:
Code
<AI Priority>
condition: target.actorId() === 1 && $gameSwitches.value(201)
</AI Priority>
In this case, the identification of the actor is always correct, but the engine does not take into account the condition in the form of a switch
